title: Braze pricing - MAU and message-based, $60K to $1M+ annually
clean_text: Braze pricing is based on monthly active users (MAU), message volume, and platform edition (Core, Pro, Enterprise), with no published flat-rate list price. Entry-level contracts typically start around $60,000 per year. Pro tier pricing ranges from $80,000 to $250,000 annually for growth-stage and mid-market companies. Enterprise deployments with 2 million or more MAUs and multi-channel advanced features range from $300,000 to over $1,000,000 annually.
